1  HON'BLE ANISH KUMAR GUPTA, J. 
1.
Heard Vinit Kumar Shukla, learned counsel for the applicants, Sri Buddhi Prakash, learned counsel for the opposite party no.2 and Sri Vinay Prakash Sahu, learned A.G.A. for the State.

2. The instant application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. has been filed seeking quashing of the entire criminal proceedings in pursuance of charge-sheet dated 27.01.2024 arising out of Case Crime No.
542 of 2023, under Sections 376, 506 I.P.C. and Section 3/4 of D.P. Act, Police Station-Dibai,
District-Bulandshahar as well as impugned cognizance order dated 27.03.2024 passed in Case No.
5074 of 2024 (State vs. Narendra @ Nareshpal Singh & Others), pending in the court of learned Chief Judicial Magistrate, Bulandshahar.
3.

entities.text:
Case No.
5074 of 2024 (State vs. Narendra @ Nareshpal Singh & Others)
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Learned counsel of the applicants submits that instant application was initially filed on behalf of three applicants namely Narendra @ Naresh Pal Singh, 2- Bhudev Singh, 3-Jagat Singh.
Vide order dated 05.07.2024 passed by the co-ordinate Bench of this Court, the instant application on behalf of applicant no. 1 was rejected.

Thus. the instant application is pending only on behalf of applicant nos.
2 & 3.
Subsequent thereto during pendency of instant application, it is alleged that parties have settled their disputes amicably and entered into a settlement.

In this regard, opposite party no. 2 has moved an application bearing no. 9489 of 2024 before the trial court stating therein that she has settled the dispute with the applicants and since she wants to marry somewhere else, thus do not want to prosecute the instant case against the applicants any further.

A short counter affidavit to the said effect has also been filed by the opposite party no. 2 in the instant case and the certified copy of said application has also been annexed alongwith short counter affidavit.

4. Thus, in the light of aforesaid application and settlement of dispute, the co-ordinate Bench of this Court vide order dated 19.09.2025 has directed the parties concerned to appear before the trial court concerned for verification of compromise.

Pursuant to the directions of this court, the parties appeared before the trial court concerned on 09.10.2025 and presented the compromise dated 09.10.2025 and in presence of the parties, the trial court has verified the said compromise.
Report dated 04.10.2025 to this effect has been received from the Civil Judge, Senior Division, Fast Track Court/Chief Judicial Magistrate, Bulandshahar.

entities.text: Civil Judge, Senior Division, Fast Track Court/Chief Judicial Magistrate, Bulandshahar
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Thus, in the light of the aforesaid compromise/settlement dated 09.10.2025 between the parties, which has been duly verified by the trial court vide order dated 09.10.2025, learned counsel for the applicants seeks quashing of the entire proceedings of the instant case against the applicants herein.
5. Learned counsel for opposite party no. 2 do not dispute the aforesaid facts and also supports the prayer for quashing of the entire proceedings against the applicants in the instant case.

He further submits that though the applicant no. 1 had established the physical relationship under the garb of promise to marry her and since the relationship between both the parties was not favourable and they were not in a position to marry with each other.

However he submits that due to pendency of the instant case, the opposite party no. 2 was not be in a position to set up herself in the matrimonial life with any other person as the pendency of the instant case would affect her future relationship with any other person.

Learned counsel for the opposite party no. 2 further submits that once the Narendra Alias Nareshpal Singh And ... vs State Of U.P. And Another on 6 November, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/32540475/
2 instant case is quashed only then there is possibility in future for the opposite party no. 2 being settled in her life with someone else.

entities.text: Narendra Alias Nareshpal Singh And ... vs State Of U.P. And Another on 6 November, 2025 Indian Kanoon
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Thus, learned counsel for the opposite party no. 2 supports the prayer for quashing of the instant case as early as possible.

6. Per contra, learned AGA, submits that since the instant application on behalf of applicant no. 1 has already been rejected by this Court and therefore instant case cannot be quashed so far as applicant no. 1 is concerned.

So far as the applicant no. 2 and 3 is concerned, the criminal proceedings can be quashed, as there is no allegation of any offence under Section 376 I.P.C. against the applicant nos. 2 & 3.
7.
Having heard the rival submission so made by learned counsel for the parties, this Court has carefully gone through the record of this case.
So far as the applicant nos. 2 & 3 are concerned, on behalf of whom the instant applicant is pending before this Court, there is no allegation u/s 376 I.P.C. against them.

The only allegation of section 506 I.P.C. and section 3/4 of D.P. Act against the applicant nos. 2 & 3 and the parties have already settled their dispute amicably and the opposite party no. 2 has also prayed that she do not want to proceed the instant case against the applicants.

Thus the instant application on behalf of applicant nos. 2 & 3 is hereby allowed and entire criminal proceedings in pursuance of charge-sheet dated 27.01.2024 arising out of Case Crime No. 542 of 2023, under Sections 376, 506 I.P.C. and Section 3/4 of D.P. Act, Police Station-Dibai,
District-Bulandshahar as well as impugned cognizance order dated 27.03.2024 passed in Case No.
5074 of 2024 (State vs. Narendra @ Nareshpal Singh & Others), pending in the court of learned Chief Judicial Magistrate, Bulandshahar, against the applicant nos. 2 & 3, are quashed.
(Anish Kumar Gupta,J.) November 6, 2025 Vibha Singh  Narendra Alias Nareshpal Singh And ... vs State Of U.P. And Another on 6 November, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/32540475/
